content.text:
I fixed the bug in `truncate` in `src/lib/strings.js`. All 13 tests now pass under `node --test`.

`truncate` cut the text to `max` characters and then added the ellipsis, so the result was `max + 1` characters long. The test expects the ellipsis to count toward `max`. I changed the slice to `text.slice(0, max - ellipsis.length)`, and I didn't touch the tests.
